$comment: Participant TCT claims-sibling convention: each participants[i].tct is a __JWS_TCT__ compact-JWS placeholder with a `tct_claims` sibling in the SAME participant object carrying the decoded claims to mint. The minter resolves each tct, strips every tct_claims companion, then signs the bundle (__VALID_A_SIG__: coordinator kat-keypair-001 over the JCS-canonical bytes of the INNER session_bundle body, excluding the `signature` member and excluding the `{"session_bundle": ...}` transport wrapper (RFC-AITP-0010 §3, RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.1) — the minted TCT strings are covered verbatim). The __VALID_A_SIG__ placeholder sits INSIDE the session_bundle body (last member), not beside the wrapper: the bundle is redistributable and carries its own proof, so a minting tool must resolve the placeholder at its inner location and write the signature back there. The only difference from bundle-001 is `input.coordinator_manifest`: it is kat-keypair-002's (B's) own valid, signed Manifest instead of the coordinator's. The runner MUST supply it as the verifier's whole coordinator Manifest source and MUST NOT fall back to the key encoded in `session_bundle.coordinator` (README, 'Manifest inputs').
description: Session Trust Bundle whose supplied coordinator Manifest designates a different agent (RFC-AITP-0010 §5 step 5, aitp/0.3 shape). The bundle is identical to bundle-001 and validly signed by the coordinator (kat-keypair-001), but `input.coordinator_manifest` is B's (kat-keypair-002) Manifest. That Manifest verifies (RFC-AITP-0003 §5), but its `aid` is not `session_bundle.coordinator`, so the coordinator's key is not resolved from the coordinator's Manifest. RFC-AITP-0007 §1: a peer key resolution failure MUST result in KEY_RESOLUTION_FAILED. A verifier that took B's key would instead fail the bundle signature (step 6); one that took the key from the coordinator AID would wrongly accept. Expected: KEY_RESOLUTION_FAILED, before the bundle signature is checked.

expected.rationale: `input.coordinator_manifest.aid` (B, kat-keypair-002) is not `session_bundle.coordinator` (A, kat-keypair-001). Step 5 resolves the coordinator's key from the coordinator's own verified Manifest; none is available, so key resolution fails with KEY_RESOLUTION_FAILED (RFC-AITP-0007 §1) and steps 6-8 are never reached.
